caption:
Global Metadata: A meditative Hindustani classical piece, 88 BPM, dreamy and devotional. Centered on the sitar (plucked long-neck lute) with its shimmering sympathetic strings and ornamented melodic lines, accompanied by the tabla (pair of hand drums) and a deep tambura drone. A warm male voice sings a devotional phrase in Hindi over the sitar, the tabla sets a gentle rhythmic cycle, the sitar plays slow ornamental phrases and then a flowing melodic passage, building to a gentle resonant peak before easing to a calm ending. Production profile: close, warm classical recording, shimmering sitar tone, crisp deep tabla, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: One lead voice, a warm devotional male singer in Hindi, natural and expressive, no auto-tune. No falsetto, no backing choir, no spoken dialogue. The voice is absent in the solo sitar passages.

Arrangement: Intro, the tambura drone and a slow sitar phrase establish the mood. Section one, the tabla enters with a gentle rhythmic cycle, the sitar plays ornamental melodic lines. Section two, the warm male voice sings a devotional phrase in Hindi over the sitar and tabla. Section three, a flowing sitar passage builds to a gentle resonant peak. Outro, the ensemble eases to a calm ending and a soft fade.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Instrumental. Tambura drone and a slow sitar phrase establish the mood
no vocals

[Section 1]
Instrumental. Tabla enters with a gentle rhythmic cycle, sitar plays ornamental lines
no vocals

[Section 2]
Om namah shivaya
शांति, शांति, प्रकाश बनो
hear the river sing to me
आलोक, आलोक, मेरे भीतर

[Section 3]
Instrumental. Flowing sitar passage, gentle resonant peak
no vocals

[Outro]
Instrumental. Eases to a calm ending, soft fade
no vocals
